name: infranodus-skills
description: InfraNodus skills: a knowledge graph + gap finder for your notes, vault or agent memory (the infranodus core skill), plus research-to-publish workflow skills: LLM wiki, ontology, project memory, perspective shifting, cognitive variability, writing, SEO and YouTube. Experimental skills moved to InfraNodus Lab.

plugins.name: infranodus
plugins.description: Knowledge graph + gap finder for your notes, vault or agent memory: shows what's missing and what to write next. Maps a folder, Obsidian vault, LLM wiki or repo into a measured, deterministic graph via the InfraNodus MCP server: topic clusters, content gaps, research questions, GraphRAG retrieval, SEO/GEO.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Collect and curate: set up and maintain an LLM wiki / second brain (Karpathy-style raw sources -> interlinked wiki pages) that compounds over time, with knowledge graph and gap analysis of what it covers. Works with the core infranodus skill.

plugins.name: ontology-generator
plugins.description: Curate: turn a topic or text into a [[wikilinks]] ontology with typed relations for Obsidian or InfraNodus, ready for knowledge graph visualization and gap analysis. Works with the core infranodus skill.

plugins.name: project-learnings
plugins.description: Agent memory for a project: proactively retrieves at task start and saves at task end what sessions learned about operating in a repo or vault to an opt-in InfraNodus learnings graph. Writes only after per-project opt-in; can be set to manual-only.

plugins.name: shifting-perspective
plugins.description: Diagnose the structural diversity of a text with knowledge graph analysis and actively shift its perspective.

plugins.name: cognitive-variability
plugins.description: Guide conversations through shifts between zoom levels and connecting/exploring modes to unlock creative breakthroughs and prevent rigid thinking.

plugins.name: writing-assistant
plugins.description: Refine texts in any language: grammar, style, paraphrasing, and grammatical pattern detection that signals cognitive states.

plugins.name: seo-analysis
plugins.description: SEO analysis: keyword research, content gap analysis, search intent, and optimization recommendations using real Google data.

plugins.name: youtube-viral-optimizer
plugins.description: Generate high-CTR YouTube thumbnails, titles, and video scripts optimized for virality and algorithm positioning.

plugins.name: infranodus-all
plugins.description: The complete InfraNodus skills collection: all 9 skills in this repo in one install: the infranodus core (knowledge graph + gap finder), llm-wiki, ontology-generator, project-learnings, shifting-perspective, cognitive-variability, writing-assistant, seo-analysis and youtube-viral-optimizer, plus the InfraNodus MCP server. Lab skills are installed separately.

plugins.name: actionize
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Turn insights or research into an actionable plan with deadlines and scheduled Telegram reminders.

plugins.name: critical-perspective
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Critical thinking: question assumptions, explore alternative perspectives, and uncover latent topics in conversations.

plugins.name: embodied-navigation
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Transfer embodied movement principles (meditation, martial arts, dance) to navigate complex situations mapped as knowledge graphs.

plugins.name: perspective-reversal
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Flip any conflict or negotiation to the opponent's perspective to extract superior tactical advice and counter-moves.

plugins.name: rhetorical-analyst
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Analyze arguments, debate tactics, and rhetorical moves across persuasion, rhetoric, and logic dimensions.

plugins.name: shopping-assistant
plugins.description: [Moved to InfraNodus Lab, repo name TBD] Systematic shopping research: comparison matrices, review analysis, and value assessment converging on the best options.
